# Installed novel entry

Read committed context using `python .novel-creator/run.py context --novel PATH
--json`. Select the novel unambiguously. The manifest pins the installed bundle;
no framework checkout is required. Python >=3.11, jsonschema >=4.23,<5 and jsonschema-rs >=0.59,<0.60 remain
environment prerequisites. Unknown or damaged records are unavailable, never an
empty story. Structural validation does not establish narrative consistency.

Preserve the current native public userMessage exactly. In Codex use native
read_thread for the current CODEX_THREAD_ID, select the one complete current
userMessage and serialize it programmatically. Stop on unavailable, truncated or
ambiguous input; this verified adapter supports a single typed text input.
Do not retype it with a PowerShell here-string, trim it or add/remove newlines.
Codex task creation and cross-task follow-ups can arrive as `functionCallOutput`
delegation events rather than `userMessage` items. Those events, their input
fields and the thread preview are not native user messages. Native mode stops
when the current turn has no native userMessage; never reuse an older message.
An explicitly authorized disposable evaluation may instead select the separate
delegated route below. Never silently fall back or relabel delegated text.
Put preparation evidence under `.novel-creator/local/evidence/`, outside receipt
discovery. Native IDs are local evidence only, never story identity.

For either source, serialize the newest public read_thread snapshot with its
thread ID and current turn ID, excluding reasoning. Run the installed launcher:
`input capture --capture-file FILE --thread-id CURRENT --turn-id CURRENT_TURN
--source native_user --json`. For authorized delegated evaluations only, select
`--source delegated --source-thread-id EXPECTED_PARENT --evaluation-only`.
The parser supports one complete codex_app create_thread/send_message_to_thread
delegation wrapper. Truncated, stale, malformed, mixed or ambiguous input stops
capture; wrapper delimiter text inside the input is currently unsupported.
Copy `data.text` exactly into the conversation user message and include
`data.input_artifact` unchanged in the exchange's input_artifacts before digest
and save. Verify equality before saving. Retain the artifact on pending retry.
It preserves source labels through fresh context; IDs are evidence, not authority.
The parser validates a supplied snapshot, not independent host provenance.
Delegated scenario decisions are simulated director inputs in this disposable
evaluation only. They cannot authorize changes in a real novel, satisfy the
native-input gate, or count as genuine novice participation or human ratings.

Prepare one conversation envelope with the confirmed expected HEAD and chain,
one exact current user message, one prepared assistant message, typed captures,
sources and honest continuity coverage. Use records.new_exchange and
records.digest, then `exchange save --novel PATH --input FILE --json`.
Wait for successful save before displaying that exact response; add no unsaved
creative suffix. Repeat automatically on every subsequent turn without requiring
another skill invocation. Bootstrap metadata does not replace conversational
capture. On failed save, disclose unsaved work, checkpoint and unchanged pending
exchange; pause further authoritative changes. A scoped filesystem retry may be
needed when the sandbox denies hard links. Never bypass held locks. An interrupted
saved response can be recovered, but display or acceptance is never inferred.

This display boundary includes progress commentary, not only the final reply.
Before confirmed save, operational updates may describe reading, preparation or
retrying, but must not disclose story ideas, captured facts, canon outcomes,
continuity judgments or checkpoint summaries. Put all such creative content in
the one prepared assistant message and save it first. Failure notices may disclose
the unsaved state as above; they must not present an unsaved creative result as
established. Display the saved message exactly, including leading/trailing spaces
and newlines; do not add a formatting newline or other unsaved text.

Only local managed metadata and exchange bundles are writable. No automatic
push, provider call, manuscript edit or hidden-reasoning capture. Review preferences
do not waive authority and persistence safeguards. Load the shared workflow for
the requested action and disclose features still unavailable in this bundle.
# Resume and inspect

Read committed context and session list using the installed local launcher.
List stable session IDs, topic, mode and open/closed state. Duplicate names do
not merge sessions. Select the requested ID; ask a focused selection question
only when ambiguity remains. Restore saved mode, focus, decisions, canon, ideas
and open questions without asking the writer to retell recorded information.
An explicit request is required to reopen a closed session; preserve its ID and
started_exchange_id. Session changes are typed revisions in the next conversation.

Expose last_saved_response with display marked unconfirmed. Offer its exact
saved text when recovering after interruption; never infer it was seen, agreed
with or accepted. Save any new conversation before showing its prepared reply.

Use `inspect --kind KIND --id ID --revision N` to retrieve current or historical
versions and sources. Derived summaries cite record revisions and checkpoint
and cannot override authoritative versions, omit unresolved conflicts or
conceal incomplete coverage. Missing/damaged/unsupported records are unavailable,
never empty context. Explain only recorded connections with sources. New
foreshadowing or motivation opportunities remain non-blocking proposals.

In the visible saved summary cite the supporting record IDs and revisions plus
the checkpoint for established facts, proposal/question groups and findings.
Session ID and checkpoint alone do not identify which record versions support
those claims. A compact reference list is sufficient; use full IDs or unambiguous
prefixes from the recovered state. Include all saved open questions, including
preference questions, without treating them as newly asked questions or adding
new creative exploration when a checkpoint pause applies.
# Brainstorming turn

Load committed project settings, selected session, source-backed canon, current
ideas, decisions, questions and availability before every response. New sessions
default to guided; resume retains the saved mode. Use records.start_session and
records.revise_session to prepare typed changes in the conversation exchange.
Topic/mode changes take effect in this response. Explicit user direction is
required to reopen a closed session. Duplicate topic names are allowed: select
by stable ID and ask only when genuinely ambiguous. Honor requests for fewer
suggestions immediately; persist that preference without deleting earlier ideas.

Normally ask one focused question. In guided mode explain a useful technique
briefly and offer meaningful possibilities when helpful. In open mode follow the
writer's exploration without forcing a questionnaire. Adapt to genre, complexity,
tone and style, and challenge weak ideas with a concrete reason and constructive
alternative. Never require a universal narrative structure. The writer can switch
between character, plot, theme, setting, worldbuilding, relationships or any other
topic. Host-provided transcription is ordinary input text; audio and spoken-output
fidelity remain the host's responsibility and require separate evidence.

Before developing suggestions perform the continuity responsibility against
relevant available facts. Read continuity.md and authority.md; distinguish their
structural enforcement from still-unverified real-host literary judgments.
Never promote an inferred interpretation to
canon. Unknown timing, unselected alternatives, praise, hypotheses and quoted
dialogue cannot establish accepted author truth.

Capture the current user message and exact prepared reply on every turn, together
with relevant ideas, characters/locations/events/plot threads, relationships,
assertions, questions, alternatives and explicit decisions. Use immutable full
record revisions with sources to exact messages/spans. Corrections retain the
erroneous prior version and identify what changed. Capture proposals as proposed
or unresolved; lack of acceptance does not mean rejection. Store mutually
exclusive alternatives separately with alternative_group_id. Record questions
with open state until an explicit resolution; unanswered questions imply no fact.
Before digesting the exchange, compare both exact messages with the prepared
captures. Save each newly raised open question as a question record, including
reader-feeling/preferences and whether a proposed direction is worth exploring;
link its exact source and add its ID to the session's unresolved_question_ids.
Reuse an existing question when repeating it; do not duplicate it or infer an
answer from a topic change. Resolve a question only from explicit direction,
retaining its prior revision. Review all new proposals and explicit decisions
in the same pass so a summary cannot silently omit uncaptured open issues.
Names are display text, never identity. Keep author truth, character knowledge,
beliefs and reader revelation distinct, with unknown timing explicit.

Apply review_preferences.routine_checkpoint: on_request summarizes when asked;
session_close also summarizes at closure; every_exchange summarizes each turn.
Put captured proposals, established decisions and open questions in the exact
saved response, and pause agent-initiated exploration until user direction.
Current explicit direction satisfies the pause; closing needs no extra approval.
Never delay saving or request another approval of an already clear acceptance.

Follow entry.md's explicitly selected input-capture and save-before-display procedure on every
turn automatically. Save session changes, captures, continuity assessment and
messages in one envelope. Only then display its unchanged assistant message.
On failure disclose unsaved work, checkpoint and unchanged pending exchange;
pause authoritative changes until safe recovery. Never edit manuscript text.
# Creative authority, decisions and revisions

Judge the user's actual statement in context. A clear commitment to an
identifiable proposition establishes only that selection without another approval.
Praise, silence, speculation, hypothetical scenes, quoted dialogue and ambiguous
pronouns do not. Ask one focused clarification for unclear targets. The validator
checks references and transitions; it cannot prove a sentence's intended meaning.

Split compound ideas into independently identified propositions before selection.
selected_parts must identify only accepted parts; never promote the entire
compound statement when only one part was chosen. Unselected alternatives remain
proposed, not rejected. Every accepted idea, element, relationship and assertion
needs a current-user decision with exact span and target/result revision refs.
Bootstrap artifacts and old approving messages cannot authorize a new change.

Decisions support accept/reject/correct/revise/reverse/resolve/defer. Preserve
current user_message_ref, exact span, selected_parts, target_refs, prior_refs,
result_refs, reason, affected_refs and review_required_refs. Retain immutable prior
record versions and original capture sources. Corrections explain the error and
use the actual correcting source; never rewrite the old exchange. Reversals create
a new version restoring the specified content, rather than resetting Git history.

An explicit canon revision identifying its target and replacement is already
authorization; do not ask again unless it crosses explicit creative direction or
an unresolved conflict. Before such a change surface that conflict and require
clarification. Review preferences cannot waive this boundary. Canon changes
never authorize edits to approved manuscript text; this feature never writes it.

When replacing an assertion, preserve old/current states and mark the old fact
superseded in the same exchange. It must not remain current canon. Link supersedes
to the precise prior version, with a sourced revision decision and result refs.
Read inspect's directly_affected list to review every recorded direct dependency.
Explain that unrecorded dependencies cannot be guaranteed detected. Preserve
unrelated facts and manuscripts; linked artifacts are review references only.

Use records.checkpoint_summary with the selected project and relevant records.
Apply on_request, session_close or every_exchange as configured. Put proposals,
established decisions and open questions in the saved response and pause
agent-initiated new exploration until user direction. Current explicit direction
satisfies that pause; session closure needs no extra acknowledgment. Summary
checkpoints never delay saving or reapprove accepted facts. They are derived
views with record/source/checkpoint references, never another authority.
